scope: Static documentation audit only. No new runtime behavior or test pass is claimed.
findings: The CLI and three compatibility launchers use the managed application path for ordinary Lean executable sources.
Application linking enables pthreads, the full Lean runtime compiled to Wasm and main execution on a guest thread; it does not instrument the application with Asyncify.
The earlier config-driven compiler and main shim use the smaller runtime, Asyncify and cooperative task draining. Callable-library parity remains a product obligation.
Earlier IO guide described every executable as cooperative and described all current IO evidence as Lean 4.32.0; both claims were stale. Existing 4.34.1 evidence remains separately scoped.
